review_evidence: README identifies sp1-lean as a Lean verification of SP1 Hypercube zkVM RISC-V chip arithmetization, proving soundness, completeness and faithfulness against Sail/Clean/extracted SP1 constraints.

The 396 current-primary files span formal contracts/traces, general math, SP1 lookup-bus models, native circuit specs, soundness/completeness proofs, faithfulness bridges, mechanically extracted constraint expressions and trace-level machine consistency.

Extracted and test-labelled sources are retained because they are central verification artifacts: extracted constraints are the exact SP1 circuit semantics used by faithfulness proofs, while SP1CleanTest contains executable/formal conformance checks. Package configuration is lakefile.toml and non-primary.
summary: Retain the entire current-primary SP1 zkVM verification corpus, including extracted constraints and conformance tests; no content-lossless primary exclusion was established.
